title: Trump says Jaxson Dart told him 'I love you, sir' at rally in new interview

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Trump says Jaxson Dart told him 'I love you, sir' at rally in new interview
sources.description: President Donald Trump was effusive in his praise of Jaxson Dart in a Fox News interview after the Giants QB spoke at one of his rallies.
